issue.title: Migrate to Expo SDK 56 CNG (Android-only)
issue.body:
## Summary

Migrate Fluent Mobile to **Expo SDK 56 Continuous Native Generation (CNG)**, Android-only. This replaces the previously committed native `android/` project with a managed, prebuild-driven workflow (`expo prebuild --clean --platform android`), and standardizes config + build tooling around Expo.

## What shipped

- **CNG / Expo SDK 56** config: `app.config.ts` (with `runtimeVersion: { policy: 'appVersion' }`), `eas.json`, EAS workflows under `.eas/`.
- **Env standardization:** removed `react-native-dotenv`/`@env` in favor of `EXPO_PUBLIC_*` via `process.env`; added `src/config/apiBaseUrl.ts` and `src/types/env.d.ts`.
- **Test stack:** migrated to `jest-expo` (`jest.config.cjs`, `jest.env.cjs`).
- **Theme + sync touch-ups** under `src/theme/*` and `src/services/sync.ts`.
- Preview-build workflow + dev-client onboarding docs.

## Attribution

Delivered by @mattrace-gloo in (merging to `main`).

## Status

**Completed** — Expo SDK 56 CNG migration merged to `main`. Tracking/credit issue.
